doc: Mano's phone (V2-24): the threads, every message in them, and the replies he can send. A message lands when its batch is delivered (`$ phone flood <batch>` delivers that batch and every earlier one in `batches` not yet delivered); the phone shows it in its thread, in order. `from` is a cast id (CastDefs) or `mano`; a classmate who is not in the cast has `from_name` instead. `at` is HH:MM, in order within each thread. Every text is at most 160 characters, with no emoji (the friends use words). Replies are tone choices, and saying nothing is always an option (the flag stays ""). {{word.key}} is filled in from data/words.json. Each friend reviewed their own messages (`slot`: true).
